episodes.synopsis: Itsuki, an ordinary guy, crosses paths with Hinako, a wealthy, perfect girl who is his polar opposite.
episodes.title: The Perfect Young Lady

episodes.synopsis: Itsuki starts his first day as Hinako's caretaker and experiences life at a top-class school.
episodes.title: Caretaker Day 1

episodes.synopsis: Itsuki is reunited with Miyakojima Narika, whose standoffish demeanor prevents her from making friends.
episodes.title: Reunion

episodes.synopsis: Itsuki grows closer to Hinako after she has a fainting spell.
episodes.title: Lies and Secrets

episodes.synopsis: Itsuki attends a business luncheon with Hinako.
episodes.title: Kidnap Me

episodes.synopsis: Mirei makes an appealing offer to Itsuki.
episodes.title: Tennoji Mirei's Proposal

episodes.synopsis: Hinako is grouchy after Itsuki spends the night out, and Mirei seems anxious about getting married.
episodes.title: A Lady's Concerns

episodes.synopsis: Mirei confronts Itsuki about the secrets he's been keeping.
episodes.title: No Lies

episodes.synopsis: Itsuki takes Mirei on a much-needed day out.
episodes.title: The Lady's Day Off

episodes.synopsis: Hinako and Itsuki try several strategies to make Narika more approachable to her classmates.
episodes.title: The Plan to Free Narika From Isolation

episodes.synopsis: Hinako and Narika face off in a tennis match for the right to an outing with Itsuki.
episodes.title: The Lady's Showdown
